# Standard Boehm-system B-flat clarinet fingerings, written MIDI 52 (E3) .. 96 (C7). Decision D-004.
# Source: Woodwind Fingering Guide (wfg.woodwind.org), Basic chart for Boehm-system clarinet
# (cl_bas_1/2/3, first-listed fingering per note) for E3..G6; Alternate chart, upper altissimo
# (cl_alt_4, first-listed fingering) for G#6..C7 (C-010). Key names: core/include/clar/Keys.h.
# Format: <written> <register 1|2|3> <vent none|register|altissimo> : <pressed levers...>
